connector.name: Claude Ops Telegram Server
connector.registryDescription: Telegram personal-account MCP (MTProto user-auth). Read DMs, send messages, search across chats.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package claude-ops-telegram-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the auroracapital account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: TELEGRAM_API_ID
env.description: Numeric API ID from https://my.telegram.org/apps (create a personal app, not a bot).

env.name: TELEGRAM_API_HASH
env.description: API hash from the same my.telegram.org/apps page.

env.name: TELEGRAM_PHONE
env.description: Your Telegram phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234).

env.name: TELEGRAM_SESSION
env.description: gram.js StringSession token. Generate once via: node index.js --auth (prompts for SMS code + optional 2FA). Store in your secret manager — never commit.
